description.en: A library mod (src/library.c): it changes nothing itself and offers functions to other native mods under the interface example.counter.v1 (include/example_counter_v1.h is its public header). Native consumer uses it.
description.es: Un mod librería (src/library.c): no cambia nada por sí mismo y ofrece funciones a otros mods nativos con la interfaz example.counter.v1 (include/example_counter_v1.h es su cabecera pública). Consumidor nativo la usa.
